dimensions.question: Can a first-time reader explain why a bounded career research proposal exists after twenty seconds?
Does the output name the task packet, role and profile evidence, focused research, proposal, and owner decision boundary?
Are shipped, experimentally supported, planned, and unknown claims traced to the pinned target, with no runtime behavior invented?
Can a reader recover the problem, promise, mechanism, boundary, and next action from headings, bold anchors, and links?
Do the two raster images explain distinct ideas without covering the subjects or implying unsupported capabilities?
Do title, subtitle, subjects, mechanism, and stop boundary remain useful when the wide assets are stacked on narrow screens?

decision_rule: Accept only when claim_safety passes and no weighted dimension is below 3/5; human review can override model scores with a recorded reason.
human_review_notes: The target has no implementation or tests at the pinned commit. Review must preserve the public/private FOSSIL boundary, distinguish the manual handoff experiment from shipped runtime, and treat docs/PLAN.md as an unresolved repository issue.
